## They apply.  Or they refer.

Every member of Ethos is both a candidate and a scout — which is how you reach the people who were never going to answer a recruiter.

OPTION 1

### Experts apply to you directly.

Your role goes out to 220,000 professionals. The ones who fit put themselves forward, already qualified.

OPTION 2

### Or they refer someone they’d vouch for.

A member who isn’t looking still knows three people who are worth your time. Referrals come with their name attached.
